verdict.summary: Lumentum is the photonics backbone of the AI datacenter revolution. The company manufactures optical transceivers, lasers, and photonic chips that are essential for high-speed data transmission inside hyperscaler data centers. Revenue surged 65.5% to $2.1B as AI infrastructure spending accelerates. Four consecutive EPS beats signal execution excellence. However, the stock trades at a demanding 47x book value and 157x EV/EBITDA, with $3.3B in debt and 16.9% short interest creating a tug-of-war between growth bulls and valuation bears.
